graph_selection_basis: Static reachability of the already published author-defined policy executor: all ten reachable directed nonself action transitions, six contexts per transition.
known_prior_result_boundary: Earlier balanced-challenge coverage and a fully excluded quota-confounded hosted policy-switch run were known. They selected service configurations, not graph edges, contexts, labels, prompts, endpoints, or reporting rules.
resource_exhaustion_rule: Ordinary service, syntax, schema, semantic, adapter, and rate-limit failures remain incorrect in the complete end-to-end denominator. If a terminal provider error explicitly states that the shared subscription quota or usage allowance is exhausted, at least 20 scheduled cells remain, and every later cell is a transport failure, the complete hosted transition-graph study is ineligible for model-efficacy reporting. In that case, retain only a redacted full-study exclusion receipt; never select a successful subset.
route_selection_basis: Reuse the two hosted configurations that produced usable decision coverage in the earlier balanced public challenge. No transition-graph output was available.
